paragraphs: See the entry R' Menachem son of R' Simai.[^1]

notes.text: The heading is the supplied epithet The Son of the Holy Ones. The pointer abbreviates both Menachem's title and the title after bar before Simai; both remain R'. The parentage reading son of is preserved without settling either title.
